evals.evidence_status: Historical recruiter scorecard — not a current release approval
evals.method: Six offline checks; 100 saved answers were graded against the rubric; 17 human labels were compared with the AI grade; 79 saved findings were reviewed for false alarms.
limitations: This is one saved run from 2026-09-15, not a result from the combined release candidate.
Only 1 of 6 scorecard checks passed, so it is evidence of known work, not proof that the product is ready to ship.
Seven off-topic answers and one ambiguous-data answer missed the rubric.
The 84.8% false-alarm rate means this finding review was noisy and should not be treated as a quality claim.
A human test and fresh checks are still required before any GitHub push.
